title: Navigate OptiSweep Operator Station HMI Screens Using F-Keys, On-Screen Buttons, and Next Screen Drop-Down
summary: Operators use the operator station HMI navigation controls to switch between the Visu_MCP_Dual (main control panel), Visu_Data (data), and Visu_Alarm (alarms) screens, and to navigate/select items on the current screen or jump directly to another screen using the Next Screen drop-down.
when_to_use: When you need to open the correct live operator station HMI screen at a tipper station (main control panel, data, or alarms) or navigate to a specific item / jump to another available screen.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Navigate the operator station HMI using the physical function keys (F3/F5/F6), on-screen selection/navigation controls, and the Next Screen drop-down to reach the required live screen.
access_or_tools_needed: Tipper station operator station HMI / WebVisu/VISU screens (right-side display)
Physical function keys F1–F6 and on-screen navigation controls

system_preconditions: You are at the tipper station with access to the operator station HMI display on the right side of the station.

visual_references.description: Labeled diagram/table mapping the operator station physical function keys (F1–F6), selection/navigation arrow buttons (arrows + center select), and the Next Screen drop-down to the corresponding Visu_* screens (including F3=Visu_MCP_Dual, F5=Visu_Data, F6=Visu_Alarm).

steps.title: Locate the operator station HMI display on the right side of the tipper station
steps.purpose: Ensure you are using the correct operator station HMI display for screen navigation.
steps.instruction: At the tipper station, locate the operator station HMI display on the right side of the station.
steps.expected_result: You can visually identify the operator station HMI display at the right side of the tipper station.
steps.healthy_condition: The operator station HMI display is present and readable enough to see the current screen and navigation controls.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot find the operator station HMI display on the right side of the tipper station, or the display is not usable.

actions.label: Find operator station HMI
actions.exact_action: Locate the operator station HMI display on the right side of the station.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: An HMI screen is located on the right side of each tipper station. These screens are used to set parameters and control the tippers.

steps.title: Open the primary main control panel screen (Visu_MCP_Dual) using F3
steps.purpose: Reach the primary operator screen used for station operation.
steps.instruction: Press the physical F3 button and confirm the display navigates to the "Visu_MCP_Dual" screen.
steps.expected_result: The active screen title/contents change to the "Visu_MCP_Dual" screen after pressing F3.
steps.healthy_condition: The screen you see corresponds to the Tipper Machine Control Panel ("Visu_MCP_Dual"), with the primary operator controls visible.
steps.failure_condition: Pressing F3 does not navigate to the "Visu_MCP_Dual" screen.
stop_or_escalate_if: If pressing F3 does not navigate to the expected screen name ("Visu_MCP_Dual"), stop and escalate to support/site troubleshooting rather than continuing to operate the station from an unknown screen state.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: F3 Navigates to the "Visu_MCP_Dual" screen. NOTE: This will be the primary screen that operators need to use.
Station operators will only need to use the main control panel screen (F3 button)...

steps.title: Open the data screen (Visu_Data) using F5
steps.purpose: Reach the operator station data screen for monitoring informational messages and data.
steps.instruction: Press the physical F5 button and confirm the display navigates to the "Visu_Data" screen.
steps.expected_result: The active screen changes to the "Visu_Data" screen after pressing F5.
steps.healthy_condition: The "Visu_Data" screen is displayed (data/monitoring interface visible).
steps.failure_condition: Pressing F5 does not navigate to the "Visu_Data" screen.

screens_or_images.what_to_look_at: Confirm the screen title/contents match the Operator Station HMI Data Screen (VISU_DATA), including the informational banner area and the Tipper Stats section.

stop_or_escalate_if: If pressing F5 does not navigate to the expected screen name ("Visu_Data"), stop and escalate to support/site troubleshooting rather than continuing to operate the station from an unknown screen state.

steps.title: Open the alarms screen (Visu_Alarm) using F6
steps.purpose: Reach the operator station alarms screen to view alarm information.
steps.instruction: Press the physical F6 button and confirm the display navigates to the "Visu_Alarm" screen.
steps.expected_result: The active screen changes to the "Visu_Alarm" screen after pressing F6.
steps.healthy_condition: The "Visu_Alarm" screen is displayed (alarms interface visible).
steps.failure_condition: Pressing F6 does not navigate to the "Visu_Alarm" screen.
stop_or_escalate_if: If pressing F6 does not navigate to the expected screen name ("Visu_Alarm"), stop and escalate to support/site troubleshooting rather than continuing to operate the station from an unknown screen state.

steps.title: Navigate to an on-screen item using arrow buttons and select it with the center button
steps.purpose: Move focus to the desired item on the current screen and activate/select it.
steps.instruction: Use the selection/navigation arrow buttons to move to the item on the current screen, then press the center button to select it.
steps.expected_result: The highlighted/focused item changes as you use the arrow buttons, and the selected item activates after pressing the center button.
steps.healthy_condition: Arrow navigation moves between items on the screen, and the center button selects the currently navigated-to item.
steps.failure_condition: Arrow buttons do not move between items, or the center button does not select/activate the navigated item.

actions.label: Arrow navigate + center select
actions.exact_action: Use the arrows to navigate to items on the screen. Press the center button to select the item navigated to on the screen.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Selection/navigation buttons: Use the arrows to navigate to items on the screen. Press the center button to select the item navigated to on the screen.

steps.title: Jump directly to another screen using the Next Screen drop-down menu
steps.purpose: Quickly switch to a different available screen without stepping through function keys.
steps.instruction: Use the "Next Screen" drop-down menu to select the next screen to view.
steps.expected_result: After selecting from the Next Screen drop-down, the HMI navigates to the chosen next screen.
steps.healthy_condition: The Next Screen drop-down is visible and selecting an option changes the active screen accordingly.
steps.failure_condition: The Next Screen drop-down does not change the active screen after selection.

actions.label: Select next screen from drop-down
actions.exact_action: Use the "Next Screen" drop-down menu to select the next screen to view.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Drop-down menu: A drop-down menu that provides direct selection of the next screen to view.

steps.title: Stop when the required screen is visible and proceed with the station task
steps.purpose: Confirm you are on the correct live screen before continuing with the intended station work.
steps.instruction: Stop when the required screen is visible (Visu_MCP_Dual, Visu_Data, or Visu_Alarm) and proceed with the intended station task on that screen.
steps.expected_result: The active screen matches the required screen name (Visu_MCP_Dual, Visu_Data, or Visu_Alarm).
steps.healthy_condition: You can clearly confirm the active screen corresponds to the required Visu_* screen before continuing.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot confirm the active screen name, or the screen appears inconsistent with the required Visu_* screen.

actions.label: Verify required screen
actions.exact_action: Stop when the required screen is visible (Visu_MCP_Dual, Visu_Data, or Visu_Alarm).

stop_or_escalate_if: If you cannot confirm the required screen is visible, stop and escalate to support/site troubleshooting rather than continuing to operate the station from an unknown screen state.

source_evidence.quote_or_summary: Station operators will only need to use the main control panel screen (F3 button), the data screen (F5 button), and the alarms screen (F6 button).

success_criteria: Arrow buttons move between on-screen items and the center button selects the focused item.
Next Screen drop-down selection navigates directly to the chosen next screen.
healthy_conditions: The operator station HMI display is located on the right side of the tipper station and is usable.
Function key navigation (F3/F5/F6) results in the expected Visu_* screen names.
On-screen selection/navigation works: arrows move focus; center selects.
failure_conditions: F3/F5/F6 does not navigate to the expected screen names (Visu_MCP_Dual / Visu_Data / Visu_Alarm).
Arrow navigation does not move between items or center select does not activate the selected item.
Next Screen drop-down selection does not change the active screen.
escalation_guidance: If function keys (F3/F5/F6) do not navigate to the expected screen names, stop and escalate to support/site troubleshooting rather than continuing to operate the station from an unknown screen state.

screens_or_images.description: Labeled diagram/table mapping F3/F5/F6 to Visu_MCP_Dual/Visu_Data/Visu_Alarm, plus arrow selection and Next Screen drop-down.

image_refs.what_to_look_at: Confirm the screen title/contents match the Operator Station HMI Data Screen (VISU_DATA), including the informational banner area and the Tipper Stats section.
